half_chest_width_cm.rule: Distribute symmetrically across front/back superellipse torso panels (3D chest circ +/-8.0 cm).

back_length_cm.rule: Anchor HPS at y=1.355 m and grade lower torso hem downward (hem band height fixed at 2.80 cm).

shoulder_breadth_cm.rule: Grade dropped-shoulder tip +/-1.5 cm per side following shoulder slope dy/dx=0.45.

armhole_depth_cm.rule: Shift underarm seam level y_underarm +1.5 cm (S) / -1.5 cm (L) relative to M=1.085 m.

sleeve_length_cm.rule: Grade sleeve centerline length along A-pose arm axis from armhole cap midpoint to cuff opening centroid.

sleeve_opening_cm.rule: Grade cuff flat half-width +/-1.0 cm (+/-2.0 cm cuff circumference).

collar_circumference_cm.rule: Grade finished collar top opening circumference +/-2.0 cm and scale neckline aperture x_neck, dips proportionally (C_open / 44.0).

hem_width_cm.rule: Grade hem flat half-width +/-4.0 cm (hem perimeter +/-8.0 cm).

chest_pocket_cm.rule: Grade pocket width +/-0.5 cm, height +/-0.5 cm, and placement proportional to chest half-width and back length while maintaining 3.5 mm normal relief.

collar_closure_convention.explanation: 2D pattern unrolls the tapered neckband onto a straight strip (end slant = sqrt(((C_seam - C_open)/2)^2 + h^2), e.g., 4.54 cm on M), whereas closing the ring in 3D distributes radial taper uniformly around the oval aperture (3D join meridian = sqrt(h^2 + delta_r_join^2), e.g., 3.10 cm on M). Cutting edge adds 0.70 cm SA at top and bottom.

pocket_attachment_convention.explanation: Planar 2D U-stitch path (e.g., 37.33 cm on M) projects onto the curved convex front torso superellipse + right shoulder slope, adding surface Z-curvature arc length (~+2.66 cm on M -> 39.99 cm 3D) plus 3.5 mm normal applique relief.
